messages.subject: Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear DrakeDarcy Team,

Your board and senior-level executive-search practice across energy, infrastructure, natural resources and government-related organisations makes this a strong fit for my profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where energy or infrastructure strategy depends on institutional trust, regulatory coordination and responsible development. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
